prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 50.8 °C (64% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 55.8 °C (55% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 57.3 °C (47% above healthy). Rapid temperature accumulation with minimal inlet-outlet drop indicates loss of cooling circulation.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.39 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.83 s (within 1% of healthy). Directional valve actuates cleanly with no discernible switching hesitation.
Pump leakage: no leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.57 l/min (within 1% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 362 W·min/l (5% below healthy). Pump delivers nominal flow rate at baseline electrical input power.
Accumulator: severely reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 45.5 bar (2% below healthy). Marked pressure ripple and reduced peak pressure indicate severe loss of hydraulic accumulator gas pre-charge.
